title: Pure P series
summary: The ':P' Series follows the cyberpunk heist rivalry and partnership between I:P Masquerena and Chiyomaru across I:P Masquerena (Link-2), S:P Little Knight (Link-2), W:P Fancy Ball (Link-3), and EM:P Meowmine! End your turn with I:P Masquerena alongside Level 2 extenders (EM:P Meowmine and the Level 2 Cyberse/Spright engine), then use I:P Masquerena during your opponent's Main Phase to Link Summon either S:P Little Knight or Link-3 W:P Fancy Ball! Because W:P Fancy Ball was Special Summoned that turn, it can banish itself until the End Phase as a Quick Effect to negate and banish an opponent's monster effect, OR use its Quick Effect during the opponent's Main Phase to Link Summon using an opponent's Link-2 or lower monster as material while EM:P Meowmine bounces another card from the GY!

allow.Spright Blue: Level 2 DARK Thunder extender that Special Summons itself while you control Level 2 EM:P Meowmine or a Link-2 (I:P Masquerena or S:P Little Knight!) and searches Spright Jet.
allow.Spright Jet: Level 2 DARK Thunder that Special Summons itself alongside EM:P Meowmine or I:P Masquerena and searches Spright Starter.
allow.Spright Red: Level 2 FIRE Thunder that tributes a Level 2 or Link-2 to negate monster effects while fueling I:P Masquerena's Quick-Link.
allow.Spright Carrot: Level 2 FIRE Thunder that tributes a Level 2 or Link-2 to negate Spell/Trap activations.
allow.Spright Starter: Quick-Play Spell that Special Summons any Level 2 Spright from the Deck to assemble I:P Masquerena + EM:P Meowmine.
allow.Live☆Twin Ki-sikil: Level 2 Cyberse 1-card starter that summons Lil-la from the Deck to immediately put a Link-2 on the board (unlocking EM:P Meowmine in your hand!) and fuel I:P Masquerena -> W:P Fancy Ball.
allow.Live☆Twin Lil-la: Level 2 Cyberse 1-card starter that summons Ki-sikil from the Deck for 1-card I:P Masquerena + EM:P Meowmine setups.
allow.Live☆Twin Sunny's Snitch: Continuous Spell that searches Live☆Twin Ki-sikil or Lil-la to guarantee 1-card access to I:P Masquerena, S:P Little Knight, and W:P Fancy Ball.
allow.Cynet Mining: Discards 1 card to search Level 2 Cyberse EM:P Meowmine, Live☆Twin Ki-sikil, or Live☆Twin Lil-la directly from your Deck.
allow.Gigantic Spright: Rank 2 Xyz that Special Summons any Level 2 monster (including EM:P Meowmine or S-Force Rappa Chiyomaru!) directly from your Deck!
allow.Spright Sprind: Link-2 monster that sends Level 2 EM:P Meowmine directly from your Deck to the GY on Link Summon—setting up Meowmine so it immediately bounces a card when you Link Summon S:P Little Knight or W:P Fancy Ball!
allow.Mekk-Knight Crusadia Avramax: Link-4 Cyberse boss that becomes completely indestructible by card effects and untargetable when Link Summoned using I:P Masquerena or W:P Fancy Ball!
allow.Underworld Goddess of the Closed World: Link-5 boss summoned during the opponent's Main Phase via I:P Masquerena or W:P Fancy Ball using an opponent's monster as Link Material!

main: EM:P Meowmine

Core ':P' Main Deck monster (Level 2 DARK Cyberse): Special Summons itself from hand if a Link Monster is on the field or in either GY; and if sent to the GY as Link Material for a Link-2 or while you have a Link-2, banishes itself from GY when a Link-2+ activates to bounce 1 card on the field to the hand!
S-Force Rappa Chiyomaru
The Main Deck identity of S:P Little Knight before she joined I:P Masquerena! Level 2 DARK Warrior that banishes an S-Force/card to bounce itself and summon from Deck.
Live☆Twin Ki-sikil
1-card Level 2 Cyberse starter that Special Summons Lil-la from the Deck to immediately assemble Link-2 I:P Masquerena and turn on EM:P Meowmine in your hand.
Live☆Twin Lil-la
1-card Level 2 Cyberse starter that Special Summons Ki-sikil from the Deck to make I:P Masquerena or Spright Sprind.
Spright Blue
Special Summons itself from your hand while you control Level 2 EM:P Meowmine, Chiyomaru, or Link-2 I:P Masquerena / S:P Little Knight, and searches Spright Jet.
Spright Jet
Special Summons itself alongside Level 2 EM:P Meowmine or Link-2 I:P Masquerena and searches Spright Starter.
Spright Red
Special Summons itself alongside I:P Masquerena or EM:P Meowmine to provide monster effect negation.
Spright Carrot
Special Summons itself alongside I:P Masquerena or EM:P Meowmine to provide Spell/Trap negation.
Cynet Mining
Searches Level 2 Cyberse EM:P Meowmine, Live☆Twin Ki-sikil, or Live☆Twin Lil-la directly from your Deck.
Live☆Twin Sunny's Snitch
Searches Ki-sikil or Lil-la to guarantee 1-card access to your ':P' Link Monsters.
Spright Starter
Special Summons Spright Blue or Jet from your Deck to put extra Link Materials alongside I:P Masquerena.
S-Force Chase
Quick-Play Spell depicting S:P Little Knight chasing I:P Masquerena that bounces opposing face-up cards.
Vivid Tail
Normal Trap depicting I:P Masquerena escaping on her motorcycle that bounces a card you control and sets a card.
S-Force Specimen
Trap depicting I:P Masquerena and Chiyomaru.
extra: Signature Link-2 DARK Cyberse: during your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect), immediately Link Summons 1 Link Monster using materials you control, including this card—and a Link Monster that used this card as material CANNOT be destroyed by your opponent's card effects!

Signature Link-2 DARK Warrior: if Link Summoned using a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Monster as material, targets 1 card on field or GY and banishes it; Quick Effect to banish 1 monster you control and 1 monster on the field until the End Phase!

Signature Link-3 DARK Cyberse boss: when your opponent activates a monster effect, banishes this card that was Special Summoned this turn until the End Phase to negate that effect and banish it; Quick Effect to Link Summon using an opponent's Link-2 or lower monster as material!
Link-2 monster that sends EM:P Meowmine directly from your Deck to the GY on Link Summon, loading Meowmine's GY bounce!
Rank 2 Xyz that detaches 1 material to Special Summon EM:P Meowmine or S-Force Rappa Chiyomaru directly from your Deck!
Link-4 Cyberse boss summoned via I:P Masquerena or W:P Fancy Ball.
Underworld Goddess of the Closed World
Link-5 boss summoned during the opponent's Main Phase via I:P Masquerena or W:P Fancy Ball using an opponent's monster!
